name: Unknown distribution contract unchecked allocation-sum overflow
summary: The 0.7.6 distribution contract's deposit 0x317de4f6(token,(recipient,amount)[]) summed allocations without overflow checks, pulled only the sum, then credited each recipient in full. The attacker paired a zero-address entry of 2^256 minus the USDT balance with a self entry of that balance, paid 1 base unit and claim()ed all unclaimed USDT; a copycat took the USDe.
notes: Direct immutable runtime; the unchecked sum in the 0x317de4f6 deposit path exists from deployment and no configuration value bears on it. Four same-code siblings from the deployer's CreateX batch never held tokens.
Loss is the contract's whole USDT and USDe balance held for unclaimed allocations; the base units the attackers paid in came back inside their claims and net out.
